text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday. I got you those nail
wraps you
said you wanted.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, I've been dying to try these!
Literally
gagged! Anything City picks
out is sure to be
straight up gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I picked out some designs I think
you'd
like. Also, is it just me, or have nail
wraps really
stepped up their game
lately?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally! They're like, so easy to apply!
And you
can layer 'em, too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, not having to scrape them off
like gel
nails is a lifesaver! My nails are
thanking me for
real.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right, they're a breeze to get off. Gel
nails are
such a pain when you have a
photoshoot...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. Didn't you say before that you
don't
really do your nails outside of
work?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know, let's try on some of those wraps
you just
gave me! Here, I'll help you put
'em on!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Um, sure, I guess... These were supposed
to be for
you, though...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well they're mine now, no? So like, I can
use them
how I want, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha... You win, girl. Go ahead.
